title: How It Works
description: Getting started with Old Ravians Academy is simple. Browse our courses, get in touch, and start learning — all from the comfort of your home.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: Browse our course listings and find a subject and level that matches your academic requirements and schedule.

steps.title: Phone Call
steps.description: Our team will contact you to evaluate your needs, clarify procedures, and match you with the right teacher and class.

steps.title: Join on Google Meet
steps.description: You'll receive a Google Meet link for your scheduled class. Attend live sessions with expert teachers from anywhere.
